items.summary: Regulators reviewing a deal to create the first coast-to-coast railroad said they have “serious concerns” after watching a video of the Union Pacific CEO’s remarks.

items.title: Earnings Upgrades Might Change Union Pacific Stock Narrative
items.summary: Union Pacific recently moved above its 20 day moving average while analysts raised earnings estimates and left none unchanged to the downside, pointing to improving expectations for the freight railroad’s profit outlook. The cluster of upward earnings revisions, rather than short term trading momentum alone, highlights how operational efficiency efforts and intermodal growth plans are increasingly central to Union Pacific’s story. items.title: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights Union Pacific, CSX and Norfolk Southern
items.summary: UNP, CSX and NSC stand out in a resilient railroad industry, with dividend growth, AI adoption and efficiency efforts supporting their prospects.

items.title: 3 Railroad Stocks to Consider From the Prospering Industry
items.summary: Headwinds, including high fuel costs, tariff-related tensions and lingering supply-chain disruptions, hurt the Zacks Transportation - Railroad industry. UNP, CSX and NSC are likely to stand out.

items.title: Union Pacific CEO’s Rate Remark May Have Silenced Merger Opponents, STB Says
items.summary: The board ordered UP to release video of CEO Jim Vena saying he might raise rates for shippers who don't support the Norfolk Southern deal.
